categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Modifies BaseIndex in src/index/base.cpp and adds an index unit test.
categories.rationale: Fixes a crash regression in pruned nodes with secondary indexes enabled during assumeutxo background validation (#36939). Discarding early flush notifications in BaseIndex::ChainStateFlushed caused index tips to lag behind until necessary blocks were pruned, triggering a fatal node crash upon completing background validation.
